items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: You know when I told you about Bricktop and Mattie Hite and all of them working in the Panama?

ctx.x: You know when I told you about Bricktop and Mattie Hite and all of them working in the Panama? Well, that's another thing I wrote down for you. Glover Compton was a pianist. And he was the husband of Nettie Compton that was there with Bricktop and them in the Panama.
